name: io.github.indyzai/openpos
title: OpenPOS
description: Task and project automation for local OpenPOS data, with read-only self-hosted Cloud access.

environmentVariables.name: OPEN_POS_DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to the local OpenPOS SQLite database.

environmentVariables.name: OPEN_POS_MCP_CLOUD_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional self-hosted OpenPOS Cloud base URL for read-only Cloud mode.

environmentVariables.name: OPEN_POS_MCP_CLOUD_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for read-only self-hosted OpenPOS Cloud mode.
